setup.title: Add your policy
setup.intro: Add your policy once to see what's left and your claims in one place. It's kept for you only and isn't sent to any insurance company.
setup.numberHint: Only the last four digits are kept.
setup.numberKept: Leave empty to keep the saved number.
setup.coverageHint: Enter what your policy lists; leave the rest empty.

problems.insurer: Pick an insurer or type its name.
problems.dates: The end date must be after the start date.
problems.member: Write a name for every person.

setup.privacy: Ritme doesn't send this information to an insurer or anyone else.

centers.title: Contracted centres
centers.emptyHint: Try a different search or centre type.
centers.note: At "direct contract" centres you only pay your own share (the deductible) and there is no claim to file.

questionnaire.title: Health questionnaire
questionnaire.subtitle: For issuing or renewing a policy

start.title: A new questionnaire
start.body: Ritme fills in what it can from your health record. You answer the rest and review every answer before confirming.

questionnaire.prefilled: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was filled in from your health record} one {1 answer filled in from your health record} other {# answers filled in from your health record}}
questionnaire.checkFirst: Check every answer yourself before confirming

q.smoker: Do you smoke or use a hookah?
q.disability: Do you have a permanent disability or physical limitation?
q.hospitalized_5y: Have you been admitted to hospital in the last 5 years?
q.chronic_disease: Do you have a chronic condition such as diabetes, high blood pressure or a thyroid condition?
q.gyn_surgery: Have you had gynecological surgery (such as a C-section or cyst removal)?
q.family_history: Does a parent, sister or brother have a serious hereditary or chronic illness?

explanation.title: Explain your «Yes» answers
explanation.placeholder: Write whatever helps, such as a medicine name or the year of a hospital stay.
explanation.hint: This note stays in your own record, encrypted.
explanation.openRecord: See it in your health record

questionnaire.warning: A wrong or incomplete answer may get a claim rejected. Your answers stay in your own record and nothing is sent to an insurer; export a PDF whenever you need one and give it to your insurer yourself.
questionnaire.incomplete: {count, plural, one {1 question is still unanswered} other {# questions are still unanswered}}

done.title: Your answers are confirmed
done.body: They are saved in your record and were not sent anywhere. Export a PDF, and note each step in «Request status» after you send it to your insurer.

pdf.title: Health questionnaire
pdf.subtitle: {purpose} · {date}
pdf.disclaimer: This sheet was built from the user's own answers in Ritme. Ritme has not sent it to any insurer.

status.title: Request status
status.intro: You note each step yourself. Ritme doesn't check with your insurer or send it anything.
status.empty: No questionnaire yet. Start with the health questionnaire.

record.title: Note a step
record.hint: Note any step your insurer told you about, right here.
